description: This Java abstract class 'BaseDosingInstructions' provides implementation for dosing instruction logic within the OpenMRS medical record system. It primarily defines a method to compute the auto-expire date for a drug order based on its duration, units, and start date.

classes.name: BaseDosingInstructions
classes.description: An abstract class implementing core dosing instruction logic, including auto-expire date calculation.

methods.name: getAutoExpireDate
methods.description: Calculates the auto-expiration date of a drug order based on its duration and start date.

methods.name: aMomentBefore
methods.description: Helper method that subtracts one second from a given date to determine a moment just before the specified date.
